SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: OUR HOME
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Our Home helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: OUR HOME
Study Our Home like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different

What this means
In this part you learn to Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Our Home” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Our Home is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Our Home” around your school. (skill: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Our Home to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Our Home from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Our Home: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Our Home?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Our Home means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. What are the (10 lessons) structures at home, environmental activities area uses of different.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
